info.title: Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: Represents the address family for this entry.

destination_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding)
IPv4 or IPv6 destination address. Example 192.168.1.255

from.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding)
'ip_directed_broadcast': The Multicast traffic will be flooded at the target subnet. 'ip_neighbor_flood': When layer-2 port goes down, traffic to an IP neighbor will be broadcast on VLAN until the neighbor's port information is re-learnt. 'static_arp_multicast' : The traffic will be replicated to participating set of ports.

hw_status.description: Status information to indicate the current state of the hardware.

replication_group_ready.description: Whether the associated replication group has been configured in hardware or not.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Neighbor_Forwarding)
Reference to a Port on which hosts might require replicating subnet L3 Multicast traffic (ex. IP directed broadcast or Static ARP Multicast). Only L3 Ports are supported: `route-only`, `SVI`, `L3 LAG`.

replication_group.description:
Reference Resource: [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group)
Reference to a Replication_Group which containts the hardware configuration for the entry.

replication_portset.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset)
Reference to a Multicast_Replication_Portset which contains a null reference in Multicast_Replication_Portset.l3_port and one or more entries in Multicast_Replication_Portset.l2_portset

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
